name: com.stormlab.unity
description: StormLab's designed supercell (the web build at github.com/jonnyglessner-jpg/StormLab) as a volumetric storm for Unity 6 HDRP, with StormLab 2.0's physical sun, sky, ground and night lighting and its lightning and thunder. The storm draws through an HDRP custom pass it installs itself.
